verdict.rationale: Heap's homepage advertises Sense Chat, an in-product chat feature that lets users skip the learning curve and "go straight to insights," which suggests a built-in assistant for analytics questions. However, this rests on a single marketing line that does not explicitly describe what tasks can be delegated or how the assistant acts. Missing for 10: documentation of Sense Chat's capabilities and which tasks it can perform (building charts, reports, queries), evidence that it executes tasks rather than only answering questions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
